acceptanceCriteria: An older-binary run against a store with slots is retained, confirming or refuting the MALFORMED refusal.
A compatibility statement or release note is recorded (or a gate implemented) and linked from the PSR spec.
body: Found by lane V1-1550 (PR beamfall/corvint#1019, head 19f66b4e4, GitHub #1008) on 2026-10-17. PSR-V0-030..038 add `slots` to policy and pools.json. Inferred from the closed decoders (older-binary compatibility run NOT_RUN): an older corvint-tasks refuses such a store as MALFORMED. Decide whether 1.0 needs a release note, compatibility statement, or a version gate before slots are declared.
title: Capacity slots: older binaries refuse a policy or pools.json carrying slots as MALFORMED
